C#/C++ Software Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a C#/C++ Software Developer for a contract opportunity in Chandler, AZ. 
 

 C#/C++ Software Developer Job Details 
 

 Develop applications at customer's direction. Focus on development of software following Agile processes. 
 
 
 Responsiblities include: 
 

 C# Desktop Application WinForms, MS Office (Excel) plugin development, scripting. . Work closely with technical customers to establish requirements and schedules. Coordinates efforts with other developers, plans functional modules, codes software to requirements, tracks and resolves software defects. 
 

 C#/C++ Software Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 C++ experience and exposure to EDA tools like Cadence Allegro, Mentor Graphics Expedition is a plus
 

 Education: BS - Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related discipline.
 

 C#/C++ Software Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 
 
 C#/C++ Software Developer Assignment Length 
 

 3 Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
